newsitem.title: USA: Viacom's MTV to invest $420 million in animation.
newsitem.headline: Viacom's MTV to invest $420 million in animation.

text.p: MTV Networks, a unit of Viacom Inc., said Tuesday that it would invest more than $420 million in original animation during the next five years.
The company said the investment would encompass animated television series, feature films and other products for its MTV and Nickelodeon cable channels.

MTV said that it would produce more than 850 half-hour animated episodes, a plan that would require a major expansion of Nickelodeon's Nicktoons Animation operation in Los Angeles and MTV's New York animation studio.
